Dated Session 1 commercial decision record now identifies the approved launch prices, promotion, trial, recovery, crossgrade, cancellation, price-version, and Founder-deferral decisions and their approving roles.
Approved Taiwan-first Pro pricing: NT$199 monthly and NT$1,990 annually, with store-authoritative localized tax-inclusive display.
Approved Taiwan-first Team pricing: NT$499 monthly and NT$4,990 annually, with store-authoritative localized tax-inclusive display.

Superseding policy approved: FERIA50 applies to Pro and Team monthly/annual launch-price cohorts. Eligible Pro buyers may combine the 14-day trial; Team has no trial. Uninterrupted verified subscriptions retain the applicable plan's 50%-off supported store price; expiry forfeits it; one redemption per owner/store account.

Approved public code FERIA50 from native public launch through 90 days later; no product-imposed redemption cap and no early-stop threshold, subject to storefront technical limits and emergency abuse/security suspension.

Apple and Google sandbox evidence must prove trial-to-paid launch-price continuity, cancellation-before-charge, inaccessible-to-ineligible cohort, lapse forfeiture, restore, crossgrade, and campaign closure before public activation.

Approved 14-day Pro trial for monthly and annual subscriptions, including FERIA50 purchases; Team has no launch trial; one trial per eligible owner/store account; cancellation during trial prevents the first charge and expiry ends entitlement and launch-price continuity.
Apple and Google sandbox evidence must prove 14-day monthly/annual Pro trial eligibility, FERIA50 stacking, cancellation with no first charge, expiry, restore-before-expiry, and repeat-trial denial.

Product policy approved: enable Apple Billing Grace Period app-wide for 16 days; verified grace preserves paid entitlement and FERIA50 continuity; verified recovery preserves price; verified expiry/revocation downgrades to Free and forfeits launch price; no client-timer extension.

Support owner approved Apple payment-failure message intent, subscription-management routing, escalation ownership, staffed hours, response targets, and verified-state-only recovery rules. Launch evidence remains separately pending.

Product policy approved: configure 7-day Google grace; verified grace preserves entitlement and FERIA50; account hold pauses paid entitlement but reserves launch-price eligibility; verified recovery restores both; EXPIRED/REVOKED forfeits; account-hold duration is store-authoritative.

Support owner approved Google grace/account-hold message intent, Play management routing, escalation ownership, staffed hours, response targets, and verified-state-only recovery rules. Launch evidence remains separately pending.

Approved Pro-to-Team policy: effective only after verified store replacement/payment; store owns proration; active FERIA50 moves to the corresponding Team launch price without a lapse; Pro trial upgrade ends trial and starts Team paid service after explicit confirmation; failure leaves Pro unchanged; Team access opens only after server verification.

Approved Team-to-Pro policy: effective at the next verified renewal boundary without immediate refund; Team remains active until then; active FERIA50 moves to corresponding Pro launch price without a lapse; no new trial; staff relationships/history/invitation records are preserved while Team access and writes are suspended; failed/canceled pending change leaves Team unchanged.
Support owner approved downgrade notice intent, staff-access explanation, escalation ownership, and verified re-upgrade/restore runbook. Launch evidence remains separately pending.

Approved cancellation/expiry policy: cancellation retains entitlement until verified paid/trial expiry; renewal restored before expiry preserves FERIA50; verified expiry/refund/chargeback/revocation downgrades to Free and forfeits launch price; resubscribe uses current standard price; readable workspace data and staff history remain while paid-only writes/access are suspended; no client-date inference.

Support owner approved cancellation/expiry/refund message intent, appeal and mistaken-revocation recovery, escalation ownership, staffed hours, response targets, and verified-state-only corrections. Launch evidence remains separately pending.

Approved price-version policy: new public prices apply to new subscribers; existing standard subscribers preserve their store price by default; FERIA50 preserves the fixed original launch-cohort price and is not recalculated against future public prices; cohort migration or applying a price decrease to existing subscribers requires separate product/accounting approval and store notice/consent behavior; client never calculates price migration.
Not applicable to the first native release because Founder acquisition and the NT$1,290 product are explicitly deferred; reopen before any future Founder launch.
Not applicable to the first native release because no Founder enrollment or eligibility evaluation will run; reopen before any future Founder launch.

Not applicable to the first native release under the approved Founder deferral. A future Founder release must reopen this item and supply Apple and Google sandbox evidence.

Product policy approved: immediate deletion after recent reauthentication and explicit pending-write resolution; no mandatory waiting period; optional delete-at-subscription-expiry cannot replace immediate deletion; active store billing does not block deletion and must be disclosed; cleanup failure remains retryable/manual review, never false completion.

Legal/privacy owner approved the immediate-deletion timing, active-store disclosure, pending-write choice, optional scheduled-at-expiry path, and scoped necessary retention exceptions, subject to pre-runtime evidence in the review packet.

Product/engineering ceilings approved for ordinary operational data: immediate access disable; primary identity/workspace/operational data and staff relationships delete or irreversibly anonymize within 30 days; product covers within 30 days; sales photos by earlier 7-day lifecycle/deletion cleanup; controlled-device cache immediately; backups within 90 days with corrective-forward deletion; scoped legal hold only.

Product/accounting/support engineering classification approved: audit/security logs 180 days; minimized support cases 2 years; detached price/subscription and store transaction/refund evidence 5 years; only legally classified accounting books 10 years and vouchers 5 years; unresolved matters/legal holds scoped; raw receipts/tokens excluded from general logs; expiry triggers deletion/anonymization.

Security owner approved the pseudonymous billing key, access-control, encryption, audit, erasure-boundary, and reidentification-prevention requirements, subject to implementation design, threat model, and pre-runtime evidence.
